summary: XCHG Ltd, a non-US (Cayman-incorporated, Hamburg-based) registrant, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's semi-annual report. The excerpt shows only XBRL taxonomy tags covering ordinary items—revenue, bank borrowings, leases, share-based compensation, related-party and customer/supplier concentration, and share incentive plans. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory term is disclosed, so this is a routine periodic report rather than a special situation.
